title: Dependant Types — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: The kinds of dependant an employee can have — spouse, son, daughter and so on. Every dependant recorded on an employee has one of these types, and health reimbursement limits are set per dependant type.

fields.label: Code
fields.rules: Optional. Left blank, the next number is assigned when the record is saved. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html:
What it is. A short code that identifies this item in its list.

Example. 001

fields.label: NameEn
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in English.

fields.label: NameAr
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in Arabic.

fields.label: Gender
fields.html:
What it is. The gender this dependant type implies — a son is male, a daughter female.

Why it matters. Recorded for information; nothing checks a dependant's gender against it.

fields.label: IsEmployee
fields.html:
What it is. Marks the type that stands for the employee themself rather than a relative.

Why it matters. Health reimbursement uses it to tell the employee's own limit apart from their dependants'. Only one dependant type can have it ticked.
